purpose: Engineering smoke on a fixed subset of the already-used NQ75 development cohort; not efficacy or unseen evaluation.
selection_reason: Four previously accepted controls and four E targets; exercise repetition, wrapped quotes, bracketed ranks, work identity, comparison, and explanations. Selected before r2 generation, with no new gold injection.
reference_policy: Original C1, evidence, gold and scorer unchanged. Initial human labels offline only; all new output reviews pending.
acceptance_policy: All 32 outputs complete; no invalid v8 stage, all three stages exercised and at least one full three-stage path. An engineering pass permits a full development rerun, never semantic acceptance or strategy promotion. v7 is an unchanged control and its known strict-parser errors are reported separately.
